articles.title: KKR Closes $23 Billion North America Private Equity Fund
articles.mainIdea: KKR Closes $23 Billion North America Private Equity Fund
articles.summary: Business Wire: KKR Closes $23 Billion North America Private Equity Fund. NEW YORK, April 02, 2026--KKR, a leading global investment firm, today announced the final closing of KKR North America Fund XIV ("NAX4" or the "Fund"), an approximately $23 billion fund focused on pursuing opportunistic private equity investments in North America through a disciplined and consistent investment approach. NAX4 is the largest private equity fund raised that focuses on investing solely in North America. Related tickers mentioned: KKR-PD.
